mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_parent cp INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = cp.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE cp.child_id = #{childId} AND cp.member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT auto_transfer_schedule_id AS autoTransferScheduleId, child_id AS childId, member_id AS memberId, request_idempotency_key AS requestIdempotencyKey, financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId, source_account_id AS sourceAccountId, destination_account_id AS destinationAccountId, amount, frequency, transfer_day AS transferDay, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, next_transfer_at AS nextTransferAt, last_transfer_status AS lastTransferStatus, last_transferred_at AS lastTransferredAt, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM auto_transfer_schedule WHERE request_idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS financialAccountId, fa.owner_type AS ownerType, fa.owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId, fa.child_id AS childId, fa.account_product_type AS accountProductType, fa.account_status AS accountStatus, fa.link_status AS linkStatus, fg.financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId FROM financial_account fa LEFT JOIN financial_goal_account fga ON fga.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id LEFT JOIN financial_goal fg ON fg.financial_goal_id = fga.financial_goal_id AND fg.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE fa.financial_account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auto_transfer_schedule ( child_id, member_id, request_idempotency_key, financial_goal_id, source_account_id, destination_account_id, amount, frequency, transfer_day, start_date, end_date, next_transfer_at, last_transfer_status, last_transferred_at, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{memberId}, #{requestIdempotencyKey}, #{financialGoalId}, #{sourceAccountId}, #{destinationAccountId}, #{amount}, #{frequency}, #{transferDay}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{nextTransferAt}, NULL, NULL, 'ACTIVE', #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT ats.auto_transfer_schedule_id AS autoTransferScheduleId, ats.child_id AS childId, ats.member_id AS memberId, ats.financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId, fg.title AS goalTitle,
ats.source_account_id AS sourceAccountId, source_account.account_name AS sourceAccountName,
ats.destination_account_id AS destinationAccountId, destination_account.account_name AS destinationAccountName,
ats.amount, ats.frequency, ats.transfer_day AS transferDay, ats.start_date AS startDate, ats.end_date AS endDate, ats.next_transfer_at AS nextTransferAt,
recent_transfer.financial_transfer_id AS lastTransferId, COALESCE( recent_transfer.status, ats.last_transfer_status ) AS lastTransferStatus, recent_transfer.failure_code AS lastFailureCode, recent_transfer.failure_message AS lastFailureMessage, COALESCE( recent_transfer.completed_at, recent_transfer.requested_at, ats.last_transferred_at ) AS lastTransferredAt,
ats.status, ats.created_at AS createdAt, ats.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM auto_transfer_schedule ats LEFT JOIN financial_goal fg ON fg.financial_goal_id = ats.financial_goal_id INNER JOIN financial_account source_account ON source_account.financial_account_id = ats.source_account_id INNER JOIN financial_account destination_account ON destination_account.financial_account_id = ats.destination_account_id LEFT JOIN financial_transfer recent_transfer ON recent_transfer.financial_transfer_id = ( SELECT ft.financial_transfer_id FROM financial_transfer ft WHERE ft.origin_type = 'AUTO_TRANSFER_SCHEDULE' AND ft.origin_id = ats.auto_transfer_schedule_id ORDER BY ft.financial_transfer_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE ats.auto_transfer_schedule_id = #{scheduleId}

SELECT auto_transfer_schedule_id AS autoTransferScheduleId, child_id AS childId, member_id AS memberId, request_idempotency_key AS requestIdempotencyKey, financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId, source_account_id AS sourceAccountId, destination_account_id AS destinationAccountId, amount, frequency, transfer_day AS transferDay, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, next_transfer_at AS nextTransferAt, last_transfer_status AS lastTransferStatus, last_transferred_at AS lastTransferredAt, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM auto_transfer_schedule WHERE auto_transfer_schedule_id = #{scheduleId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE auto_transfer_schedule SET amount = #{amount}, transfer_day = #{transferDay}, end_date = #{endDate}, next_transfer_at = #{nextTransferAt}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE auto_transfer_schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
